$comment: Fixture + corpus spec for the W4.1d4 search/introspection tool differential (request_full_context, project_info, help_search, search). ONE two-DB fixture (main + mount-index) is baked once; each oracle/harness case runs on a fresh copy. Canned embeddings are dim-8 (query dim must equal stored dim). cosineSimilarity here is a raw dot product (vectors NOT re-normalized), so a unit basis-vector query e_k dotted with a stored vector whose k-th component is s yields exactly s — giving exact control over which items clear minScore (0.3) and their ordering. Every store/character/project/chat/memory id is pinned so request_full_context + project_info compare with ZERO normalization; the char-vault mount id is minted and read back on both sides. P4.D77 (v4 24633026): help_search now scores SECTIONS as well as documents. The helpDocs vectors were re-spread so the five docs have distinct cosines (they were all parallel to e3, hence all 1.0, so the ranking was decided by insertion order alone), and helpDocChunks carries the five section rows whose arms are documented row by row.
$safety: testPepperBase64 is the SAME throwaway key the tiered-mount-pool + other fixtures use — never a real pepper.
$nowMsComment: 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z — the Date.now() seam the memory branch's effectiveWeight/decay reads. Pinned identically on both differential sides.

helpDocs._note: P4.D77 — cosine EXACTLY 0.0 against the query, and its only section is dimension-mismatched. This is what makes scoreSections' dimension guard observable at all: v5's cosine returns an error on a length mismatch and the caller floors it to 0.0, so a mismatched chunk can never win a max() — but it CAN pass `best.score >= docScore` when the document itself scores 0.0, attaching a matchedSection v4 never attaches. Drop the guard and this row grows one.
